method: ARX(24 lags, 10-min differences of ht.T6, ht.F9, PAK 30-min mean), beta = mean cumulative PAK response at 3-8 h to a sustained +1 C step in T6; window (2025-01-01, 2025-12-31 18:00:00] = 12 months before tau minus 6 h guard; rows = unit running >=12 h before and 6 h after (T6,T5>320 C, P13>3 MPa, F2>30000, F9>q01=134.5 t/h, no NaN), PAK valid (0.05-50 mg/kg, not frozen >=1 h); ci = month-block bootstrap 90% (40 draws); drift = same ARX per half-year starting at tau (realized, not trailing); flow_beta null: F9 lags enter the ARX only as a control, no identified sustained flow effect (F9 vs F26 as flow tag changes beta by <0.002); rolling-origin realized/estimate ratio of the trailing-12 rule 0.97-1.71 over 2024H1-2026H1 (bootstrap ci understates next-half uncertainty)
